paragraphs: In Bava Kamma 80a: Rabbi Acha bar Pappa said in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Pappa, in the name of Rabbi Ada bar Pappa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The chain Acha bar Pappa — Abba bar Pappa — Ada bar Pappa appears in the William Davidson digital text of Bava Kamma 80b. Hyman’s supplied locator is 80a, retained in the translation.

The actual whole Davidson Bava Kamma 80b paragraph explicitly gives the Acha–Abba–Ada bar Pappa chain with full Rabbi titles. The two alternative chains in that paragraph are not substituted into Hyman’s report. Source 80a and the current note remain unchanged; no shared-father inference or locator repair is made.
